idea-plugin.name: htmxRazor Live Templates
idea-plugin.description:
Live templates (code snippets) for all htmxRazor Tag Helper components in ASP.NET Core Razor views.

Type rhx- in any .cshtml or HTML file to see the available templates. Each template expands the full tag with commonly used attributes as interactive variables.

97 templates covering:
  • All 85+ htmxRazor components
  • htmx-integrated variants (button, input, combobox)
  • Multi-component composition (card with header/footer, tab group with panels)
Requires the htmxRazor NuGet package.
